default/31744.htm.text: Ogmar: Kassandra was born with the soul of dreaming flames... It's that ability that's passed down to the prophets of the Duda-mara Orcs. I can't imagine why such a blessing was given to a child of Dwarves, but it is surely the will of Paagrio. Until her fate becomes known, I'll protect Kassandra w…

Q00241_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul1/31744-0.text: Ogmar: Kassandra is my friend Virgil's child. I saw the Grand Seer about her once, he said her nightmares are depleting her strength. He can make the drug to cure her!
Ogmar: The Sage's Library is under this building. Find Grand Seer Rahorakti there.

Q00242_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul2/31744-0.text: Ogmar: Kassandra never had normal dreams. She may have the blood of a shaman in her veins. This nightmare must be a message. Please tell me about her dream.
Ogmar: Look for a clue on the path to the Gateway of Evil Spirits in the east of the swamp.

Q00241_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul1/31744-0.text: Ogmar: You'll find Grand Seer Rahorakti in the Sage's Library in the basement of this building.

Q00242_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul2/31744-0.text: Ogmar: Tejakar Paagrio! That must be the Swamp of Screams. The valley between two tall peaks, that must be around the Gateway of Evil Spirits in the east of the swamp. Maybe we should look around there.
